who_choose_description: In the World of Dota universe (based on Dota 2), there are many diverse heroes, each with unique abilities and playstyles. The playstyle can change depending on how you choose to upgrade talents and which items you select for your hero. This allows players to adapt their hero to their strategy or the needs of the team, making every match unique and unpredictable.

og_description: World of Dota (WoDOTA) — a unique custom Dota 2 game with new modes and hero talents
about_intro_text: WoDOTA is a website about World of Dota where you'll find information about all the heroes and past tournaments, follow the vote for the next hero, and explore other useful materials for the community
about_devices_alt: Responsive WoDOTA website interface across different devices
about_history_subtitle: Select any milestone on the timeline to explore the history of the WoDOTA website
about_history1_title: The Idea to Create the Website
about_history1_text: The idea to create a website dedicated to World of Dota came to me while working on a social network as part of a team project. At that point, I wanted to build a website on my own, so I decided to dedicate it to a game I had spent countless hours playing
about_history2_text: This was the day the real development of the website began: the first line of code was written, the first files were created, and the initial structure of the website started to take shape
about_history3_text: After several months of development, with long breaks along the way, the website gained its core sections: Heroes, Voting, and the Leaderboard. Although I originally wanted to include more pages and features before release, I decided not to delay the launch any longer and released the first version of WoDOTA
about_history4_text: The website continues to evolve. I regularly improve the design, add new features, fix bugs, and refine the existing sections. Development is ongoing, and many more updates are still to come
about_early_subtitle: Stories about what the site looked like before its official release
about_early1_before: In the early versions of the website, before its official release, the main navigation was located on the left
about_early1_after: The main navigation was moved to the top. In my opinion, this change improved the overall look of the website and made navigation more intuitive
about_early2_before: When creating the hero page, the design was based on how the hero appears in Dota 2. One version even included a 360° 3D model that could be rotated
about_early2_after: Later, the 3D model was abandoned in favor of video. This preserved the hero's visual presentation while significantly improving page loading speed
about_author_subtitle: WoDOTA is a project that I create and develop on my own. Everything you see on the website is the result of one person's work
about_author_role1_text: I design the website's appearance, plan the layout of its sections, and strive to make the website easy and intuitive to use
about_author_role2_text: I develop both the frontend and backend, from implementing page designs to building the server-side of the website
about_author_role3_text: I collect and regularly update the information on the website to keep all data accurate and up to date
about_author_role4_text: I answer questions, fix bugs, and make sure the website runs smoothly and reliably
about_author_role5_text: I translate the interface into multiple languages to make the website convenient for people from different countries
about_author_role6_text: I optimize the website for search engines to make WoDOTA easier for new users to find
about_news_subtitle: I share all WoDOTA news and updates on the Telegram channel. Subscribe to be the first to know about everything happening on the website and never miss an update
about_news_list_label: Here's what you'll find on the Telegram channel:
about_news_qr_hint: Scan the QR code to open the Telegram channel
about_news_qr_alt: QR code to access the WoDOTA Telegram channel
tg_notice_text: Want to be the first to know about website updates and important news? Subscribe to our Telegram!
faq_q1: I'm a YouTuber — how can I get featured on the “WoDOTA CONTENT” page?
faq_a1: Contact the administration and submit a request to add your channel. All contact methods are available on the “Contacts” page
faq_q2: How do I change the site language?
faq_a2: Open settings in the top-right corner and choose the interface language you want. On a phone, open the menu, then go to settings in the bottom-right corner and change the language
faq_a3: Open settings in the top-right corner and click the log-out icon. On a phone, open the menu, go to settings, and use the same log-out icon
faq_q4: What should I do if I find a bug?
faq_a4: Go to the “Contacts” page, pick a convenient contact method, and report the problem
faq_q5: Why might the talents on the site differ from those in the game?
faq_a5: I update the data separately from the game's developer, so there may be delays in keeping the information current
faq_step1: Go to the heroes page and select the hero you want
faq_step2: Scroll down to the talents section and click the “Start improving” button
faq_step3: Choose talents one by one to create your build
faq_step4: After distributing the talents, click the “Save” button
faq_step5: Choose a save format: a link or an image
